title: Is organic better? — Harvard Gazette
summary: A food-policy scholar tells the Harvard Gazette organic food is not more nutritious or safer, mostly comes from industrial farms, and needs more land.

assertions.quote: there is no reliable evidence showing that organically grown foods are more nutritious or safer to eat
there were no convincing differences between organic and conventional foods in nutrient content or health benefit
more than 99 percent had residues safely below EPA’s tolerance levels
produce in supermarkets has been washed to remove nearly all of the chemical residues that might remain
most now come from distant industrial farms
we would also have to plow up more land to produce the same amount of food
If we follow the science, organic food loses its apparent advantage.
